items.t: Fuel injector "spider" assembly problems
items.job: Replace spider fuel injector assembly and intake gaskets
items.note: The upper intake must come off. Repair any fuel leak right away.

items.t: Four-speed automatic slipping
items.job: Replace with remanufactured 4L60-E transmission
items.note: A used unit costs less. A local rebuild is also common and may cost less.

items.t: Excess oil consumption
items.job: Replace pistons and rings and AFM oil shield
items.note: Some trucks are helped first by a cheaper valve cover or oil shield fix; ask the dealer.

items.t: Lifter failure on V8s with cylinder deactivation
items.job: Replace lifters, camshaft and lifter guides
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the engine must be replaced. Some vehicles have a lifter warranty; ask the dealer.

items.t: Brake assist loss recall
items.job: Replace brake vacuum pump
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: 6.2L engine recall for rod and crank defects
items.job: Replace engine under recall
items.note: Covered under the recall if the VIN qualifies; some engines only need inspection and an oil change. Ask the dealer.

items.t: Heated windshield washer module can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Disable and remove heated washer module
items.note: Free under recall 10V-240. Check the VIN first.

items.t: A/C stops cooling from a cracked condenser
items.job: Replace A/C condenser, evacuate and recharge

items.t: Eight-speed automatic shudder at steady speed
items.job: Transmission fluid exchange to revised fluid
items.note: A worn torque converter costs far more if the shudder is left too long.

items.t: Magnetic Ride Control shocks leak or knock
items.job: Replace one Magnetic Ride Control shock
items.note: Per shock. Front struts take longer than rear shocks.

items.t: Ten-speed transmission valve can lock the rear wheels (recall)
items.job: Update transmission control software
items.note: Free under recall 24V-797 or 26V-085. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Accelerator cable can snag and hold the throttle open (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reroute or replace accelerator cable
items.note: Free under recall 96V-057. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wipers can stop from cracked circuit board solder joints (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper control circuit board or module
items.note: Free under recall 98V-150. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front brake rotor can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace front brake rotors in pairs
items.note: Free under recall 98V-033. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering shaft pinch bolt can loosen and fall out (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace steering shaft pinch bolt
items.note: Free under recall 97V-142. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front passenger belt falls short of a federal restraint standard (recall)
items.job: Replace front passenger seat belt assembly
items.note: Free under recall 00V-122. Check the VIN first.

items.t: ABS can grab on its own at low speed (recall)
items.job: Replace front wheel speed sensor and update ABS module
items.note: Free under recall 05V-379. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Missing body plugs can let exhaust fumes into the cabin (recall)
items.job: Install missing wheelhouse and body plugs
items.note: Free under recall 00V-343. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake pipe can rub the body and leak fluid (recall)
items.job: Replace brake pipe and bleed brakes
items.note: Free under recall 00V-345. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Head restraint gap can pinch fingers (recall)
items.job: Install head restraint pinch-point correction
items.note: Free under recall 02V-253. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hydro-boost brake assist seal can split (recall)
items.job: Replace hydro-boost unit and bleed brakes
items.note: Free under recall 04V-045. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear center belt can ride up onto the stomach (recall)
items.job: Replace rear center seat belt assembly
items.note: Free under recall 05V-163. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear door hinge welds may be out of specification (recall)
items.job: Inspect rear door hinge welds and repair as needed
items.note: Free under recall 03V-037. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake pedal pushrod retainer can be missing (recall)
items.job: Install brake pedal pushrod retainer clip
items.note: Free under recall 05V-103. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering hose can split at full lock (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering pressure hose and flush system
items.note: Free under recall 05V-455. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tire and loading label shows the wrong capacity (recall)
items.job: Install corrected tire and loading information label
items.note: Free under recall 05V-552. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Ignition lock can bind and snap back out of Run (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder and relearn key
items.note: Free under recall 14V-827. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Contaminated control module can short and stall the truck (recall)
items.job: Replace affected control module and reprogram
items.note: Free under recall 14V-614. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Park lock can fail and let the truck roll (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace transmission park lock components
items.note: Free under recall 13V-001. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wheel speed sensor fault can brake one wheel by itself (recall)
items.job: Replace wheel speed sensor and reprogram brake module
items.note: Free under recall 19V-761. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump assembly can leak from a missing regulator (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module
items.note: Free under recall 19V-837. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Daytime running lights can stay on with the headlights (recall)
items.job: Reprogram body control module lighting software
items.note: Free under recall 22V-827. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Third-row seat belt buckle rivet may be formed wrong (recall)
items.job: Replace third-row seat belt buckle assembly
items.note: Free under recall 22V-617. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear control arm bolts can break (recall)
items.job: Replace rear outer control arm bolts and align
items.note: Free under recall 23V-642. Check the VIN first.

items.t: No warning light if brake fluid runs low (recall)
items.job: Reprogram instrument cluster software
items.note: Free under recall 24V-674. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wrong diesel fuel tank can leak in a rollover (recall)
items.job: Replace diesel fuel tank
items.note: Free under recall 25V-619. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wrong front hub bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Replace front wheel hub bolts and torque to spec
items.note: Free under recall 26V-304. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Missing transfer case part can lock the wheels (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Inspect transfer case and install missing component
items.note: Free under recall 26V-289. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transfer case can lock the wheels without warning (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Inspect transfer case and install missing component
items.note: Free under recall 26V-289. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Radio may be missing the electronic owner's manual (recall)
items.job: Download electronic owner's manual to radio
items.note: Free under recall 26V-114. Check the VIN first.
